## Why drains slow down

Grease and food scraps build up in the trap.

## The three checks {#action-plan}

### 1. Clean the trap — about 15 minutes {#task-trap}

Put a bucket under the trap and unscrew the cap.

**Done when:** water runs through freely. **Stop if:** the fittings are corroded.

## FAQ

### Can I use boiling water?

Only on metal pipes.
